headline: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent questions Nvidia's culture of export compliance and urges an outside CEO search
new_fact: On November 15 Bessent said on Fox News that Nvidia would face regulator intervention if it were a bank, called for an outside CEO search, and said Treasury had backed blacklisting Megaspeed for months.
